(NYSE: HUM) will release its financial results for the fourth quarter 2022 (4Q22) on Wednesday, February 1, 2023, at 6:30 a.m. Eastern time. The company will host a conference call at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time that morning to discuss its financial results for the quarter and earnings guidance for 2023.

To participate via telephone, please register in advance using this link, https://register.vevent.com/register/BI4189468fb19c466d8457e
